provenance.sent_by: Schwab REST option chain (get_option_chain, strike_range=ALL), each expiry's contracts as sent
provenance.recorded_by: capture daemon ChainSweep (its one writer); chain_json is stored gzip-compressed and is decompressed here as `chain`
provenance.query: SELECT ticker, expiry, ts_utc, spot, n_contracts, completeness_basis, chain_json, source FROM complete_chain_captures WHERE ticker=? AND ts_utc>=? AND ts_utc<? AND completeness_basis='every_expiry_strike_range_ALL' AND expiry IN ('2026-10-14','2026-11-06','2026-11-13') ORDER BY expiry
provenance.note: three whole expiries of each ticker's 2026-10-02 morning sweep, each ticker at one instant (SPY 09:32:23 ET spot 769.62, TSLA 09:30:47 ET spot 362.01); TSLA 2026-11-13 has 63 strikes that list only contracts with open interest 0, 62 of them with contracts whose Greeks Schwab sent as -999
